values.Orbit data source / flags: Trend only. Quadratic RV term -4.1e-6 +/- 0.2e-6 m/s/day^2 and linear 0.032 +/- 0.002 m/s/day fitted simultaneously with b (Table 7). Mass-period degenerate (Fig. 17-18); the 16.2 AU value is only the nominal a used for stability runs (stable for e<0.2). No period, no mass. May be substellar. TIER: Only an RV trend (linear + quadratic terms fitted alongside b) from one team's McDonald/Keck data. No closed orbit: period and mass are degenerate beyond ~1e4 d, so it could be a planet or a brown dwarf. The authors rule out psi1 Dra A as the cause and see no matching Ca II activity, but note moderate S_HK power at periods longer than the baseline, so a slow activity trend cannot be fully excluded. No follow-up found.
